Score Summary: Measures your Content, Delivery, and Simplicity. Metrics in the
zone get +10 points. Total Grade out of 100.
Green Score: Counts how many of the 9 metrics hit the perfect Green Zone (+10). Each green metric adds +1 to this score. Getting all 9 greens awards a +1 bonus, for a perfect 10/10.
Grade: Your final score out of 100. It is the sum of your 9 core metrics (max 90 points) plus your Green Score (max 10 points).
Content: Measures the substance of your speech. Aim for 30-60% Personal and 20-50% Visual.
Delivery: Measures how you sound. Aim for 100-150 Words/min, 3.5-4.5 Syllables/sec, and 15-35% Pause time.
Simplicity: Measures how easy your speech is to understand. Keep Runtime between 3.0-6.0s.
Personal: Measures storytelling. Aim for 30-60% content about specific people doing specific things.
Visual: Measures sensory words that paint a picture. Aim for 20-50%.
Intangible: Measures abstract concepts and filler. Keep it between 10-30%.
Words/min: Your speaking pace. The sweet spot is 100-150 words per minute.
Syllable/sec: Our 'Mumble Meter'. The green zone is 3.5 to 4.5 syllables per second.
Pause %: The percentage of time you spend silent. Aim for 15-35%.
Runtime: The average seconds you speak continuously before taking a meaningful pause. Aim for 3.0s to 6.0s.
Comp. Grade: The reading grade level of your speech. A grade of 5.0 to 10.0 is perfect.
Simple %: The percentage of your words within the 10,000 most common English words. Aim for 80-90%.
In 3sec chunks, counts how varied is your pause lengths. Varrying pause lengths affects meaning.
In 3sec chunks, counts how varied is your speaking volume. Varying volume is engaging.
In 3sec chunks, counts your slow and fast sentences. Varying rhythm & cadence is engaging.
